summary.name: Subler
summary.one_liner: Subler is a macOS app for muxing and tagging MP4 files, as described in the listing that points to this Bitbucket repository.
use_cases: Muxing separate audio, video and subtitle tracks into an MP4
Editing metadata on movie files on a Mac

The listing that linked here describes Subler as a macOS app created to mux and tag MP4 files. Beyond that description, the page itself gives no details on capabilities, versions, or usage.
